tools.name: search_products
tools.title: Search products
tools.description: Search the JOFA public product catalog (lingerie, robes, bin bin, pagne, thiouraye) by keyword and return matching products with prices and links.

query.description: Keywords to search for, e.g. 'lingerie dentelle' or 'binbin'. Omit to list featured products.

limit.description: Maximum number of products to return (default 10).

tools.name: get_product
tools.title: Get product details
tools.description: Get full public details for one JOFA product by its handle: description, price, images, available sizes and variants.

handle.description: Product handle (slug), as returned by search_products, e.g. 'ensemble-sophie'.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.title: List categories
tools.description: List the public JOFA shop categories and Shopify collections, with links to browse each one on the storefront.
